## Professional summary

César Gómez is a senior fullstack developer with a frontend focus. He builds high-performance websites and web products with Vue 3, Nuxt 4, TypeScript, Pinia, PrimeVue, and Tailwind CSS from Cartagena de Indias, Colombia. He has led frontend architecture for ed-tech platforms serving 100,000+ students and contributed as a founding engineer on speech-based language learning products. He also ships production Node.js/Express APIs and integrates AI/NLP models (local + cloud) into real products.

## Core expertise

- Vue.js and Nuxt.js (Vue 3, Nuxt 4, Composition API, Pinia, Vue Router, Vite, SSR/SSG, performance)
- Senior frontend development and custom website / páginas web delivery
- TypeScript and modern JavaScript
- Design systems, micro-frontends, and component libraries (PrimeVue, Vuetify, Tailwind CSS)
- Core Web Vitals, accessibility (a11y), and UI engineering
- AI/NLP engineering (local + cloud models, Ollama, llama.cpp, conversational/speech) and agent-assisted delivery to production
- Node.js backend APIs with Express.js (8+ years in production) and TypeScript API contracts
- Fullstack delivery connecting APIs to Vue/Nuxt products
- CI/CD (GitHub Actions) and maintainable production craft
